## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/unit/scripts/test-apply-attribution-trailers.sh exists
  Verify: test -f tests/unit/scripts/test-apply-attribution-trailers.sh
- [ ] test_read_and_deduplicate_returns_single_value_for_duplicate_agents function present
  Verify: grep -q 'test_read_and_deduplicate_returns_single_value_for_duplicate_agents' tests/unit/scripts/test-apply-attribution-trailers.sh
- [ ] test_read_and_deduplicate_preserves_two_distinct_agent_types function present
  Verify: grep -q 'test_read_and_deduplicate_preserves_two_distinct_agent_types' tests/unit/scripts/test-apply-attribution-trailers.sh
- [ ] test_check_git_version_stub_returns_0 function present
  Verify: grep -q 'test_check_git_version_stub_returns_0' tests/unit/scripts/test-apply-attribution-trailers.sh
- [ ] Tests are RED (fail) against the current codebase before T3a-impl is implemented
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test-apply-attribution-trailers.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'FAIL\|not found\|No such file'
